scope: Corollary 9.3 (Multiplicativity of the perverse filtration) of the manuscript “P=W in composite rank for fixed determinant” (preprints/P-equals-W-in-composite-rank-for-fixed-determinant-September-24-2026/P-equals-W-in-composite-rank-for-fixed-determinant-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 043 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the setting of the all-rank corollary above, use the normalization (1.2). For all i, j ≥ 0 and a, b ∈ Z, PaHi (X, Q) ⌣ PbHj (X, Q) ⊆ Pa+bHi+j (X, Q). Put Γ = Pic0 (C)[n] and PaHi(X, C) = PaHi(X, Q) ⊗Q C. For the pullback-action isotypic parts indexed by χ, ψ ∈ b Γ = Hom(Γ, C×), one also has PaHi (X, C)  χ ⌣ PbHj (X, C)  ψ ⊆ Pa+bHi+j (X, C)  χψ . This includes trivial and distinct characters, with the same normalized P on every character summand.
